description: The autonomy.grant refusal for an allow on a non-root node (S56 T6, the -31833 family, AL3): allow grants sit on a root component only; a veto may sit on a child (OD4) but an allow may not, because an allow on a child would be authority the root's own view does not show. The daemon checks the node's parent before the pure validator and the sentence names the parent root — the actionable half a bare not-a-root omission would leave out.

data.what: refused: allow grants sit on a root component; pkg/web is not a root — its root is aeon (AL3)
data.means: a grant is a human-authored authority record with closed rules (subject, conditions, expiry, the node it may sit on); a request outside them is refused, not silently corrected — nothing was written
data.todo: the refusal names the rule it broke and the thing it broke it on; `autonomy.vocabulary` lists the closed sets a request may name
